# ANBU

ANBU is a Vietnam-based marketing agency helping game publishers, mobile apps and technology brands enter Vietnam, Thailand and Southeast Asia. Site languages: Vietnamese (/vi) and English (/en).

## Core services
- Esports and gaming influencer marketing: https://anbu.asia/en/services/esports-gaming-marketing-sea
- Game and app marketing: https://anbu.asia/en/services/game-app-marketing
- Influencer and KOL/KOC marketing: https://anbu.asia/en/services/influencer-marketing
- Publisher search and launch partner matching in Vietnam: https://anbu.asia/en/services/publisher-search
- Performance marketing: https://anbu.asia/en/services/performance-marketing
- SEO and content: https://anbu.asia/en/services/seo-content
- Brand strategy: https://anbu.asia/en/services/brand-strategy
- Creative and design: https://anbu.asia/en/services/creative-design
- Social media management: https://anbu.asia/en/services/social-media
- Web and app development: https://anbu.asia/en/services/web-development

## Editorial note
Figures on this site are public numbers with a source, or are confirmed by ANBU. Video views are whole-video counts and are rounded down. Game-level figures describe the product, not ANBU's own results.
